dedupe_keys.name: siradel telecom planning suite inowave rf digital twin volcano propagation and 3d geodata

description: Siradel, active since 1994, provides radio propagation modelling, network planning software and 3D geodata for telecom operators, equipment makers, researchers and cities. Its Volcano propagation model underlies the Siradel 360 telecom suite. Siradel InoWave is a research-grade RF digital twin: a telecom digital twin of indoor and outdoor scenes with 3D ray-tracing propagation and support for MIMO, reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS), non-terrestrial networks, joint communication and sensing, V2X, UAVs, fixed wireless access, HAPS and millimetre-wave and sub-THz bands, used to simulate emerging 5G, beyond-5G and 6G technologies. Other offerings listed are a network planning tool (Bloonet Planner), a network planning API, an urban hypervisor, risk management software and a climate resilience platform. Its geodata services build 2D and 3D geodata and city models from LiDAR, base maps, field surveys, open data and IoT, structured to OGC and INSPIRE standards, with AI-based object extraction. Coverage: generic software; geodata by project. Format and access: licensed software and custom data services, with demos on request. Licence: proprietary; terms and prices were not read. Caveats: the planner, API and resilience platform pages were not opened. Simulation uses: site-specific radio coverage and interference studies and digital twins of wireless networks. Related records: a Siradel railway ray-tracing MIMO channel dataset is recorded in this catalogue, and Sionna (model-sionna) is an open ray-tracing alternative.
